text: Official MCP server lets an AI tool read workspace data, manage automations and one-time sends, and work with segments via natural language
quote: With the MCP server, you can do just about anything you can do in Customer.io via your AI tool of choice—read workspace data, create and manage automations and one-time sends, work with segments, and more—all through natural language prompt

text: Connected AI can do anything a user can do by clicking or typing in the UI, such as building automations, drafting messages and analyzing performance
quote: Your AI can do anything you'd do by clicking or typing in Customer.io. That means you can have it build automations, draft messages, analyze performance, and so on.

text: Connected AI client can build segments, draft emails, and report on message performance
quote: your AI client can then do the work for you: build segments, draft emails, or report on how your messages perform.

text: Official CLI gives AI agents and scripts full access to Customer.io workspaces
quote: The Customer.io CLI is a command-line tool that gives AI agents and scripts full access to your Customer.io workspaces.

text: CLI covers the Journeys UI API and CDP Data Pipelines API through a single generic command with no per-endpoint code
quote: It covers the Journeys UI API and CDP Data Pipelines API through a single `cio api` command—no per-endpoint code, no SDK boilerplate.

text: CLI commands return structured JSON and endpoints are self-describing via a schema command
quote: Every command returns structured JSON, every endpoint is self-describing via `cio schema`

text: Installable skill teaches AI assistants how to drive the CLI
quote: install our skill—a set of instructions that teaches your AI assistant how to drive the CLI.

text: Claude plugin available through the plugin marketplace
quote: /plugin marketplace add customerio/claude-plugin

text: Agent read, write and delete operations are separated so each category can be approved independently
quote: Reads are separated from writes and deletes... so you can approve each category independently.

text: Ingest data via SDKs or the Pipelines API, which underpins most integrations
quote: To get data into Customer.io, use an SDK or the Pipelines API. This is the API that most of our integrations are based on and likely the API you'll use the most.

text: Pipelines API natively supports objects and relationships via a /group endpoint
quote: The Pipelines API natively supports objects and relationships through the /group endpoint.

text: Track API sends real-time customer data, including identifying customers and tracking events
quote: Our Track API provides ways to send real-time customer data to your Customer.io workspace including customer identification and event tracking.

text: Delete or suppress a profile by sending Delete Person or Suppress Person track events
quote: if you wanted to delete a profile, you'd send a track event with a name parameter called Delete Person. If you want to suppress a profile, you'd send an event called Suppress Person.

text: App API sends broadcasts and transactional messages and fetches data
quote: To send broadcasts, transactional messages, and fetch data (outside of a _data out_ integration), use the App API.

text: Broadcasts configured in the UI can be triggered with a single API call
quote: Trigger broadcasts: you'll set up a broadcast in our UI and then trigger it with a single call.

text: Transactional API sends one-to-one messages such as password resets and receipts, with message data passed in the call
quote: When someone does something that requires a transactional message, you’ll call our transactional API to send them a message—like when they request a password reset or need a receipt for a purchase.

text: Postman collection provided to get started with the APIs
quote: We've generated a Postman collection to help you get started with our APIs.

text: OpenAPI spec published covering the Track, App and Design Studio APIs
quote: Primary OpenAPI spec for the Track (ingress), App, and Design Studio APIs together, at the conventional path

text: Mobile SDKs identify people and send push, rich push and in-app messages to app users
quote: Identify people and send push, rich push, and in-app messages to your mobile app users.

text: JavaScript client snippet works as a data source for data-out integrations
quote: Our JavaScript client snippet is the easiest to get started with and is universally supported as a source of data for our data-out integrations.

text: Automations trigger when profiles perform events or join segments based on attribute conditions
quote: You can trigger automations when profiles perform events, when they join Segments (e.g. they meet attribute conditions), and so on.

text: Automations combine a trigger, goals, exit criteria and workflows to send messages and manipulate data
quote: It consists of four major components: Trigger... Goals... Exit criteria... Workflows

text: Multiple delays can be chained in a single Wait Until block
quote: Chain multiple delays together in a single _Wait Until_ block

text: Broadcasts queue a message to a list of recipients for sending at a specified time
quote: Broadcasts send a message to a list of recipients. Broadcast messages are queued to send to all the defined recipients at a time you specify.

text: Sends automated messages over email, push, in-app, web, SMS, Slack and webhooks
quote: Customer.io is a platform for sending automated messages — email, push notifications, in-app and web messages, SMS, Slack, and webhooks

text: In-app messages are supported for multiple mobile apps in one workspace
quote: Support in-app messages for multiple mobile apps in the same workspace

text: Design Studio includes a drag-and-drop visual editor and a code editor
quote:
Drag-and-drop visual editor

Included

Included

Included

Code editor

Included

text: AI can draft emails such as a welcome email in Design Studio
quote: Draft a welcome email in Design Studio.

text: AI-generated global styles for message design
quote: AI-generated global styles

text: Inbox preview credits support email inbox previews in Design Studio
quote: Inbox preview credits are the currency for [email inbox previews in Design Studio]

text: Assets library stores images and PDFs for reuse across messages
quote: Your workspace has an Assets library where you can store images and PDFs for reuse across messages (email, in-app, etc.).

text: Describe segment lets the in-product agent build a segment from a plain-text description
quote: When you go to create a segment, you can click **Describe segment** and the agent will help you build a segment from a plain-text description.

text: Built-in agent can analyze your workspace
quote: The agent can analyze your workspace

text: Agent runs recurring scheduled tasks such as deliverability reports, segment audits and broadcast recaps
quote: You can set up recurring tasks that the agent runs automatically on a schedule—like deliverability reports, segment audits, and broadcast recaps.

text: Customer.io agent can be added to Slack to answer questions or take on work from a thread
quote: You can add the Customer.io agent to Slack, and ask it questions or give it work without leaving a thread.

text: Data-out integrations send data to analytics, CRM, support, advertising and messaging platforms
quote: Data-out integrations let you send data to platforms outside of Customer.io, like analytics platforms, CRMs, support tools, advertising platforms, messaging platforms, and more.

text: Native Snowflake and BigQuery integration with reverse ETL syncing as often as every minute
quote: Customer.io offers native data warehouse integration (Snowflake, BigQuery) with reverse ETL that syncs as frequently as every minute.

text: Each integration has its own API key for sending data in
quote: Each integration has an *API Key*, which lets you send data to Customer.io.

text: Synthetic email addresses with an email relay support data residency and PII requirements
quote: you can use synthetic email addresses with an email relay. Customer.io sends messages to the synthetic addresses, and your relay forwards them to the real recipients.

text: Audit logs track changes to account, workspaces, messages and assets
quote: Audit logs help you track changes made to your account, workspaces, messages, and other assets so you can keep your account secure and troubleshoot issues.

text: Accounts are automatically verified at signup by reviewing website, domain and use case
quote: We automatically verify your account when you sign up with Customer.io. We review your company website, domain, and use case to make sure we can support your messaging needs while maintaining our high deliverability standards.

text: Agency partner matching helps create a transactional migration plan
quote: Go to our [Agency Partners page](https://customer.io/agency-partners), click **Get Matched**, and fill out the form; we’ll pair you with an agency that can help you create a transactional migration plan.
